Definition: to cover over (the mouth), i.e. to fast
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tsûwm is the word for to fast. In Judges 20:26, fasted that day until even. Wherever it appears, the word means this and not something vaguer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe to fast is to say with the body what the heart already knows, that God is more needful than bread. That is why I come back to tsûwm whenever I need to remember what is true.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
